Subject: SIG questionnaire — timeline and deliverables

Hi Michael,

Thanks again for taking the SIG for ClearBank. Our procurement and InfoSec teams have an internal deadline to complete vendor SIGs and collect evidence by Friday, 31 May. Can you confirm Redwood's ability to: 

- Complete the SIG questionnaire with first-pass responses by Tuesday, 23 May
- Deliver the supporting evidence bundle (network diagrams, SOC2 artifact index, encryption/config docs) by Friday, 26 May

We'd also like a short mutual action plan listing Redwoods' owners for each artifact and an expected date so our reviewers can triage. Attached is our latest requirements PDF — a few items are marked high-priority for us (network segmentation, key management proof, and SOC2 mapping).

If those dates are infeasible, please propose alternatives — procurement is flexible but needs visibility today.

Thanks,
Elena

Elena — thanks for the clear priorities and the deadline context. We've reviewed the attachment and can commit to a concrete two-stage plan: 

Stage 1 (SIG responses, draft): Tue 23 May — Michael (owner)
- Deliver: completed questionnaire rows with inline notes and outstanding data flags. We'll mark anything that needs longer-running evidence collection.

Stage 2 (evidence bundle): Fri 26 May — Priyom (owner)
- Deliver: network diagram, SOC2 evidence index (control-to-evidence mapping), KMS/HSM configuration summary, and sample logs where allowed.

A couple of notes up front:
- For some SOC2 artifacts we may need to provide redacted examples (audit reports, log excerpts); please confirm redaction is acceptable for procurement review.
- Network diagrams: we will provide a high-level diagram (per your requirements) by 26 May; a more detailed internal diagram requires a customer NDA addendum which we can discuss if needed.

I've attached an early response workbook (SIG_response_draft_v1.xlsx) so you can see our intent and where we've left in-line questions. Priyom will take point on collecting the evidence kit and will loop Monica for the final artifact upload.

If that schedule works, please reply "ack" and we'll treat timeline as locked. If you need earlier delivery for any single artifact (e.g., SOC2 mapping), call that out and we'll prioritize.

—Michael
